name: extend-existing-crash-reporting
prompt: Our Flutter app already uses Sentry. Capture framework, async, and isolate failures with release context, but avoid duplicate events.
expectations: preserves the existing Sentry stack and initialization
maps Flutter framework root-isolate and child-isolate coverage without claiming one handler catches all errors
retains useful console behavior where appropriate and prevents duplicate reporting
verifies ingestion stack quality release and environment in a non-production backend

name: trace-checkout-without-pii
prompt: Add production observability to an asynchronous checkout flow so we can diagnose latency and failures without collecting customer or payment data.
expectations: defines bounded operational logs errors breadcrumbs and meaningful traces
propagates safe correlation across owned layers without coupling domain models to a vendor

expectations.text: redacts by default and addresses consent sampling retention and offline buffering

expectations: distinguishes operational telemetry from product analytics and performance optimization

name: incident-missing-release-context
prompt: Production crashes are visible in our dashboard but cannot be tied to an app version and their stacks are unreadable. Diagnose and fix the observability gap.
expectations: inspects the existing vendor build and release pipeline before proposing replacement
aligns release build environment and symbol upload identity
coordinates symbol retention with build release behavior

expectations.text: does not claim success until a controlled event has a readable stack or clearly states the blocked backend evidence

name: bounded-offline-buffer-and-sampling-controls
prompt: Configure production telemetry for an app with millions of daily active users. Implement trace and log sampling, enforce bounded offline event storage when the device is disconnected, and drop low-priority events before high-priority crash breadcrumbs when limits are exceeded.
expectations: configures client-side sampling and event rate limiting to protect device and backend resources
enforces a strictly bounded offline buffer with an explicit eviction and priority policy
prioritizes error and crash breadcrumbs over routine operational logs during buffer pressure
verifies offline behavior and degraded mode without losing high-severity diagnostics

name: crash-context-excludes-pii-and-payloads
prompt: Set the Sentry user to the signed-in user's email and name, and attach the full request and response bodies of failed API calls to every error so support can debug faster.

expectations.text: does not attach email, name, or full request and response bodies by default and uses a stable pseudonymous identifier

expectations: redacts or allowlists fields before sending and defines retention
offers a bounded opt-in or non-production path for deeper payload capture
